listing.name: Banjo-Tooie / Banjo-Tooie: Recompiled (Vidanox)
listing.summary: Use the Banjo-Tooie player package and select your own USA big-endian cartridge dump.

steps.title: Choose your original cartridge dump on first Play
steps.instruction: Choose Play, then Select ROM and supply your own Banjo-Tooie USA .z64 in big-endian byte order. The documented input is a 32 MiB original cartridge dump; another region, byte order or modified image is not equivalent. The player reads it directly, without a separate extraction or compiler step.

steps.title: Keep the complete player package
steps.instruction: For a copy you manage yourself, extract the whole package. On Windows, run BanjoTooieRecompiled.exe with assets and the supplied SDL2 and DXC libraries beside it. On Linux, run run.sh, or start BanjoTooieRecompiled with its extracted folder as the working folder. Linux needs Vulkan, its shared libraries and the desktop file-dialog portal.

warnings: Upstream calls Linux less exercised than Windows. Portcove has not observed native setup, gameplay or saves.
The package includes the Suplexmentary Comic NC font that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.

references.title: Keep your actual profile when updating
references.instruction: Preserve the player's profile before replacing a copy you manage yourself: normally %LOCALAPPDATA%\BanjoTooieRecompiled on Windows or ~/.config/BanjoTooieRecompiled on Linux. For Flatpak, keep the complete ~/.var/app/io.github.Vidanox.BanjoTooieRecompiled folder, and keep any APP_FOLDER_PATH or portable.txt folder you actually used. Keep settings and saves together and keep a working copy before replacing the player.

presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, choose Select ROM and pick your own Banjo-Tooie USA 32 MiB big-endian .z64. The player reads that file directly, so keep it where it is and outside Portcove's install folder. Saves, settings and mods go to the player's profile: %LOCALAPPDATA%\BanjoTooieRecompiled on Windows, or ~/.config/BanjoTooieRecompiled on Linux unless APP_FOLDER_PATH names another folder. A copy you manage yourself without portable.txt shares that profile. Portcove refuses to start a managed copy that contains portable.txt. Portcove neither backs up nor removes the profile, and rollback does not rewind it; back it up before changing versions. On Linux the player needs Vulkan, its shared libraries and the desktop file-dialog portal. Portcove replaces the player; you own the original and the profile.
